extension.description: See which Claude Code and Codex agents are working, stuck or waiting for you, as a live team call: subagents join, share their screen and report back. A dashboard of every session, token usage per agent, replay and voices. Mistral Vibe and Cowork too. It only reads local files and costs no tokens.
command.open.title: Agent Standup: Open live call
command.openInBrowser.title: Agent Standup: Open in browser (voice + sound)
command.focus.title: Agent Standup: Show sidebar
command.openCharacters.title: Agent Standup: Open characters folder (your own pixel art)
view.name: Live call
config.port.description: Local port of the Agent Standup server. 0 (default) picks a free port automatically for each VS Code window.
config.autoOpen.description: Open the live call automatically when VS Code starts.
config.onlyThisWorkspace.description: Follow only Claude Code sessions started in the current workspace folder.
config.statusBar.description: Show live counts in the status bar (agents working, needs you, your turn) for this workspace; the item turns red when a session waits for your answer (a question or a permission is open).
config.shareUsage.description: Help the project count how many people use it: once a day when the editor starts, and at most once a week when you open the call, send one empty request to a 1-pixel file on GitHub (no identifier, no content; GitHub sees your IP like for any download). Off until you say yes (asked once, the first time you open the call); ignored if VS Code telemetry is off.
config.codex.description: Also show Codex sessions (read from ~/.codex/sessions, or $CODEX_HOME). Turn off to show Claude Code sessions only.
config.vibe.description: Also show Mistral Vibe sessions (read from ~/.vibe/logs/session, or $VIBE_HOME). Turn off to leave them out.
config.reply.description: Let the call type your message into the followed Claude Code session's tmux pane (Linux only, off by default). Anyone who can run commands as you can then type into your sessions.
config.claudePath.description: Full path to the Claude Code executable, if it is not found automatically (used for translation).
config.charactersPath.description: Folder with your own character images (PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 300 KB each). Empty uses ~/.agent-standup/characters. lead.png is the lead, you.png is you, any other image is a sub-agent, name-talk.png is an optional open-mouth frame.
config.leadName.description: Name of the lead agent in the call (its forks are named after it: Name 2, Name 3…). Empty uses the name chosen in the call’s settings, or Margot. 24 characters at most.
config.notifyNeedsYou.description: Show a notification when a session of this workspace starts waiting for you (a question, an approval, a plan), naming the session and what it asks; once per wait, never a reminder. Not shown while the call is in view, nor while you are on that session's Claude Code tab.
